name: LMDeploy time-per-output-token (TPOT) histogram
notes: InternLM/lmdeploy main, PrometheusStatLogger in lmdeploy/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default and requires NO flag: the endpoint is simply available at the API server port (23333 by default). Label keys are model_name and engine on every metric, where engine carries the dp_rank. Bucket construction reuses vLLM's build_buckets / build_1_2_5_buckets idiom. Named time_PER_output_token (vLLM's is request_time_per_output_token_seconds) and its ladder starts at 0.005 rather than vLLM's 0.01, so it is NOT the same bucket list under a different name. Observed in record_iteration() from stats.tpot.
